_doc: Historian (ADR-0019) - single source for the historian service, the provisioner (TimeSeries LinkedSegment of every device AAS) and the MES (production-based PCF). InfluxDB 3 Core, one table per device (lower-case FMI instance name = UNS device segment), one field per FMI output, tag 'session'. public_url is the host view written into the AAS; services inside compose use VF_INFLUX_URL. Reference: docs/interfaces/services.md#historian
